checks.label: Static main text and one H1
Self-canonical authored pages, no accidental noindex
Sitemap lastmod matches explicit modified date
Individual rendered Markdown documents with hashes
HTML declares its Markdown alternate and llms index
Curated index under 12 KiB, grouped Markdown links
Complete revision-matched manifest and section locations
Export retains every code block and prose heading
Raw source hashes and committed source links
All public article hashes match source review records
Page-specific JSON-LD with matching title, URL and dates
Visible authors, modified date and source reference
Nonempty page description and opening answer text
Six walkthroughs declare goal, prerequisites, effects and checks
Current Sorti identity and legacy redirects verified
Version-matched curated task retrieval and citation checks
Public HTML, robots and discovery endpoints reachable
Actual crawl/index and external AI citation measurement

examples.scope: Pure parser and configuration checks, not a created live panel, real browser-proxy session, or shared-library write.

limitations: Retired identifiers remain in explicit compatibility maps, negative tests, review history and Git history.
Text and SVG scanning does not read every raster image or video pixel.
Current code fingerprints are not a live deployment or complete third-party-service revalidation.
Pinned historical source contributions retain their original scope.
Readiness v2 changes the identity requirement; do not silently compare it with v1.
